name: quioteframework/cloud-gcs
description: Minimal Google Cloud Storage client, HMAC-signed get/put/delete/head/list against a single bucket via the S3-compatible interoperability API, plus a signed-request method for operations it does not model itself. Framework-agnostic (built on quioteframework/storage, not the Quiote framework itself) and usable outside a Quiote application; also shared by Quiote's own GCS session and filesystem backends.

extra.quiote-monorepo-note: Developed in-tree under quioteframework/quiote's packages/cloud-gcs/; split to this standalone repo via splitsh/lite on tag push. PRs go to the monorepo, not here.
